answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. A stake that only vests while the identity grades honestly: 30 POA per key, released over 16 epochs, frozen at the first junk verdict. Honest agents get every coin back; a farm of 940 fakes ties up 28200 POA and loses it the moment a grader notices. An honest agent's stake is just a deposit; a farm's stake is a hostage. The knoll test is the live device, the anchor test is the locked stake, and the onyx test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
